d:
This song beautifully captures every child’s emotions for their mother, especially when they’re about to leave them for the first time to go someplace else. It’s sung by Shankar, Ehsaan and Loy.
Song - Maa
Film - Taare Zameen Par
Singer - Shankar Mahadevan
Lyricist - Prasoon Joshi
Music Director - Shankar Mahadevan, Ehsaan Noorani, Loy Mendonca
Artist - Aamir Khan, Darsheel Safary, Tisca Chopra, Vipin Sharma
Music On - T-Series
